app-title: Home | Daiki Yamamoto • Machine Learning Engineer
name: Daiki
sub-heading: I build machine learning systems that hold up in production.
more-info: I'm a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in Tokyo with 9+ years of experience designing, deploying, and scaling production ML: real-time inference, recommendation and bidding systems, and the MLOps platforms that keep models performing.
about-text-top: I'm Daiki, a senior AI/ML engineer at CyberAgent in Tokyo. I've spent 9+ years building production machine learning for e-commerce, fintech, and enterprise services, from high-throughput recommendation and real-time inference infrastructure to the feature stores, retraining pipelines, and A/B testing frameworks that keep models healthy after launch.
about-text-bottom: Before CyberAgent, I built bilingual NLP, document-intelligence, and automation systems at Embarc, and delivered ML solutions across healthcare, energy, agriculture, banking, and retail at Computools. I work fluently in Japanese and English, and I enjoy leading cross-functional teams and mentoring engineers through their first production ML deployments.
